## What changed

Describe the smallest complete change.

## Why

Connect the change to a user need, accepted decision, or verified defect.

## Trust and evidence review

- [ ] No unsupported product, market, traction, or outcome claim was added.
- [ ] No model output can authorize a side effect or infer a sensitive answer.
- [ ] Consequential actions preserve approval, idempotency, audit, and recovery.
- [ ] New external claims are dated and recorded in the source register.
- [ ] MVP, later-phase, and out-of-scope behavior remain distinct.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Responsive behavior checked when the interface changed.
- [ ] Relevant Markdown links and Mermaid diagrams checked.
